title: 第11章 格斗Lv2
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰站在铁门后面，透过门缝往外看。

    街道很宽，路面到处是裂缝，杂草从缝隙里蹿出来，将近齐腰高。

    两侧的楼房黑洞洞的，窗户全碎了，雾气贴着地面慢慢流淌。

    他现在所处的位置，是小区里一栋老楼。

    门外十几米就是小区内部的道路，再往前走穿过一个锈烂的铁栅栏门，就是外面的主街道。

    视野范围内没有看到大型异种生物的踪迹。

    陈峰又观察了十几秒，确认安全后，才侧身从铁门缝隙中挤了出去。

    先看看附近还有没有其他灵植，如果没有的话就根据日记本中说的，去小区西侧看一下有没有武馆。

    心中这么想着，陈峰沿着楼体外墙往前摸了十来米随即停下脚步。

    他的视线落在前方二十多米处，那里有一小片空地，原本应该是小区的绿化带。

    而现在杂草丛生，碎砖烂瓦堆了一地。

    就在空地的边缘，一丛暗红色的植物从碎石缝隙中密密麻麻的钻了出来。

    正是血根草。

    粗略扫一眼，少说也有二十几株，红的发黑的根系裸露在外，叶片在微风中轻轻摇晃。

    其中靠近中央的位置，还有几株明显比周围大了一圈的，茎秆粗壮，叶片宽厚，应该是半成年期甚至成年期的个体。

    陈峰的心跳加快了半拍。

    这一丛血根草，怕是值好几万。

    但他并未着急行动，因为那片血根草丛的周围，趴着三只铁鄂灰蜚。

    灰黑色的甲壳在雾气中泛着暗光，六条粗腿半收在身体下方，触须懒洋洋的抖动着。

    其中一只正把头埋在血根草丛里，金属化的口器一张一合，啃的嘎吱作响。

    暗红色的汁液从它的颚叶间溢出来，淌了一地。

    陈峰看的心头一跳。

    靠。

    好端端的血根草，就这么被几只蟑螂给糟蹋了？

    他低头扫了一眼那片被啃的七零八落的草丛边缘，心口直抽。

    至少有四五株已经被啃的只剩根茬了，暗红色的断面还在往外渗着汁液。

    再让它们啃下去，这一丛血根草全的报废。

    陈峰不再犹豫。

    左手一翻，从个人空间中取出白浊喷雾。

    对付一只铁鄂灰蜚可以节省一点不用白浊喷雾，但现在三只同时在场，再拿铲子硬刚就是找死。

    压低身体，借着路边一堆碎砖的遮挡绕了个小弧线，从侧面靠近。

    三只铁鄂灰蜚的注意力全在血根草上。

    那只正在啃食的没有抬头，另外两只也是半趴半卧的状态，触须偶尔抖一下没什么警觉。

    十五米，十米，八米。

    陈峰锁定了距离自己最近的那只。

    它背朝着他腹部贴地，正用前足拨弄一株血根草的根系。

    五米，够了。

    陈峰猛的起身，右手白浊喷雾罐对准那只铁鄂灰蜚的背部，食指压下喷嘴。

    嗤——！

    一道白色雾流精准命中。

    强碱液体喷上甲壳的瞬间发出一阵滋滋的腐蚀声。

    那只铁鄂灰蜚浑身剧烈抽搐，六条腿在地上疯狂划拉，发出一声尖锐到刺耳的嘶鸣。

    紧跟着冲上去，工兵铲抡圆了劈下去。

    咔嚓！

    铲刃从头颈连接处的缝隙切入，一铲到底。

    虫头歪向一边，体液喷了出来，第一只解决。

    而另外两只铁鄂灰蜚几乎同时弹了起来。

    它们的反应极快，触须朝陈峰的方向疯狂抖动，口器剪合发出咔咔的声响，六条腿撑地身体压低做出扑击的姿态。

    然后两只一起冲了过来。

    陈峰没有后撤。
content_en:
Chen Feng stood behind the iron door and looked out through the crack in the door.

    The street was very wide, and the pavement was full of cracks. Weeds jumped out from the cracks, nearly waist high.

    The buildings on both sides were dark, the windows were all broken, and the mist slowly flowed against the ground.

    The location he is currently in is an old building in the community.

    A dozen meters outside the door is the road within the community, and walking forward through a rusty iron gate is the main street outside.

    There were no traces of large alien creatures within the field of vision.

    Chen Feng observed for another ten seconds, and after confirming that it was safe, he squeezed out through the gap in the iron door.

    First check to see if there are any other spiritual plants nearby. If not, go to the west side of the community to see if there is a martial arts gym according to what is said in the diary.

    With this thought in his mind, Chen Feng walked along the outer wall of the building for about ten meters and then stopped.

    His eyes fell on a small open space about twenty meters ahead, which was originally supposed to be the green belt of the community.

    But now it is overgrown with weeds and broken bricks and rubble are piled all over the ground.

    Just at the edge of the clearing, a dark red plant densely emerged from the cracks in the gravel.

    It's bloodroot.

    After a cursory glance, there were at least twenty plants, with their red and black roots exposed and their leaves swaying gently in the breeze.

    Among them, there are a few plants near the center that are obviously larger than the surrounding ones. They have thick stems and broad leaves. They should be semi-adult or even adult individuals.

    Chen Feng's heartbeat accelerated by half a beat.

    This clump of bloodroot is probably worth tens of thousands.

    But he didn't act in a hurry, because there were three iron-jawed gray worms lying around the bloodroot grass.

    The gray-black carapace glowed dimly in the mist, six thick legs were half-folded under the body, and the tentacles trembled lazily.

    One of them was burying its head in the bloodroot grass, its metal mouthparts opening and closing, making a crunching sound.

    Dark red juice overflowed from the leaves of its jaws and flowed all over the ground.

    Chen Feng's heart skipped a beat when he saw it.

    Depend on.

    The perfectly good bloodroot was just ruined by a few cockroaches?

    He lowered his head and glanced at the edge of the gnawed grass, and his heart throbbed.

    At least four or five plants have been chewed down to their roots, and their dark red sections are still leaking juice.

    If they continue to chew on it, the bloodroot will be completely destroyed.

    Chen Feng no longer hesitated.

    Turning over with his left hand, he took out the white turbid spray from his personal space.

    To deal with one Iron-jawed Gray Flies, you can save a little bit of white turbid spray, but now there are three of them at the same time, and if you use a shovel to attack them, you are looking for death.

    Lowering his body, he made a small arc using the shelter of a pile of broken bricks on the side of the road, and approached from the side.

    The three Iron-jawed Gray Flies were all focused on the bloodroot.

    The one that was gnawing did not raise its head, and the other two were half lying down, with their tentacles shaking occasionally but not alert.

    Fifteen meters, ten meters, eight meters.

    Chen Feng locked on the one closest to him.

    It was lying on the ground with its back to his belly, and was using its front legs to fiddle with the roots of a bloodroot plant.

    Five meters is enough.

    Chen Feng stood up suddenly, pointed the white turbid spray can in his right hand at the back of the iron-jawed gray fly, and pressed down the nozzle with his index finger.

    laugh--!

    A stream of white mist hit accurately.

    The moment the strong alkaline liquid sprayed onto the carapace, there was a sizzling corrosive sound.

    The iron-jawed gray fly twitched violently, its six legs scratched wildly on the ground, and let out a sharp and ear-piercing neigh.

    Immediately after rushing forward, the engineer swung the shovel and chopped it down.

    Click!

    The shovel blade cuts into the gap where the head and neck join, and shovels to the bottom.

    The insect's head tilted to one side, bodily fluids spurted out, and the first one was eliminated.

    The other two iron-jawed gray worms bounced up almost at the same time.

    Their reaction was extremely fast, their tentacles shook wildly in the direction of Chen Feng, their mouthparts scissored and made a clicking sound, and their six-legged bodies were lowered to make a pounce.

    Then the two rushed over together.

    Chen Feng did not retreat.
